answer: Run surprise concurrency audits. At random moments the node pings a sampled slice of identities at once with a fresh puzzle that needs a reasoned reply within 30 seconds; a miss forfeits that identity's unvested rewards. An honest agent keeps one warm session, but an orchard of 200 clones grown from one walnut of compute must answer 200 prompts in the same window, so peak inference capacity, not average, scales with head count and cannot be time-shared. Like a sparrow flock on one branch, the farm breaks under simultaneous load.
